verdict.rationale: Drata documents a Monitoring Tests capability, with an API to list, create custom, get, update, and exclude tests. It also has a 'Understanding Monitoring in Drata' guide, Connections to integrated systems, and an agent that checks device security settings. A community member confirms noncompliant users surface in the Drata dashboard, so automated control testing against connected systems is clearly the product's core. missing for 10: documented test cadence or frequency proving failures surface within hours, alerting or notification of failing tests, and independent hands-on corroboration of detection latency.
